cards.t: Arbitrum Integrates Paxos USDG Stablecoin with ARB Incentives
cards.b: Arbitrum is joining the Paxos-led Global Dollar group and launching USDG, supported by a proposal for 100 million ARB in incentives to drive adoption and liquidity.

per.ARB: Set to receive 100 million tokens in proposed incentives to support USDG stablecoin adoption and liquidity on the network.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact distribution schedule for the 100 million ARB incentives.

cards.t: Solana Foundation Unveils Open-Source Institutional Settlement Program
cards.b: The Solana Foundation launched an open-source DvP program designed to allow financial institutions to settle trades atomically in seconds, developed with input from JPMorgan.

per.SOL: Gains institutional tooling via the DvP settlement standard built with input from J.P. Morgan.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Adoption timeline by specific institutional participants.

cards.t: Ethereum Sepolia Testnet Deploys Glamsterdam Upgrade
cards.b: Ethereum successfully launched the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Sepolia testnet following a validator client software update. The upgrade aims to increase work capacity per block to 200 million gas.

per.ETH: Testing capacity increases targeting 200 million gas per block on Sepolia ahead of mainnet activation.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact mainnet launch date for the Glamsterdam upgrade.

cards.t: Metaplanet Q3 Holdings Reach 44,000 BTC via Net Accumulation
cards.b: Japanese firm Metaplanet added a net 1,000 Bitcoin in the third quarter, bringing its total holdings to 44,000 BTC alongside a revised capital allocation strategy.

per.BTC: Corporate treasury expanded total holdings to 44,000 coins.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Specific details of preferred securities income generation.
